page.title: Findings & Fixes
page.purpose: Show what diverged from declared experience intent and let an operator preview and apply the fixes that can be made mechanically.

priorities.statement: Severity and what-diverged are readable before anything else.
A fix is always previewed before it is applied.
Findings speak in next-unlock language: what diverged, what is still safe, what unlocks the next level.

states.description: All green: explicit no-divergence content, celebrated honestly — not blank space.

elements.description: Textual severity on every finding row.
Per-finding link to the Evidence view.

claims.statement: Findings are exposed as a list with an accessible name.
Severity is stated in text on every finding — never conveyed by color alone.
Preview precedes Apply in reading order wherever both appear — the safe act is met first.
Every finding's evidence link is keyboard reachable.
The all-green state renders explicit no-divergence content instead of an empty list.
Finding copy states what diverged from declared intent and what unlocks the next maturity level, mirroring business-health's ladder language.
